h1: Etsy customer messages, answered the way you would
overview: We read your Etsy inbox, learn how you talk to buyers and answer in the same voice. That covers product questions, shipping updates, custom request quotes and polite replies to complaints. We build a set of saved replies for the questions you get most, so every message is quick and consistent. Anything about refunds or cases is passed to you first. Messages stay inside Etsy, as the rules ask.

pkgs.blurb: More conversations handled, including custom requests.
A complete message routine, with templates for every common case.

faq: Will buyers know it is not me?
We write in your tone and sign as your shop. We do not pretend to be a named person, and we tell you which replies we sent. If you want a note saying a team helps, we can add that.
Can you accept custom orders and quote prices?
We collect the details, work out a price from your rate sheet and send a quote. You approve the price before we send it, and the order goes through Etsy's own custom listing tools.
What about angry or unfair messages?
We stay calm, reply with facts, and pass anything about refunds, cases or legal claims to you before sending. We never argue with a buyer or push them to remove a review.
Premium includes drafts for public review replies, which you approve before posting. We never ask for reviews in exchange for anything, and we follow the Etsy rules on review requests.
